pages.title: getAvailable
pages.text: $(method)getAvailable()$()$(br2)Catalog of free stock (and craftable flags) visible from this request pipe.$(br2)$(note)Returns$()$(br)$(li)$(field)name$() $(type)string$() — item id$(li)$(field)count$() $(type)number$() — free stock$(li)$(field)craftable$() $(type)boolean$() — craftable on this network$(br2)$(note)Example$()$(br)$(code)$(kw)local$() t = p.$(method)getAvailable()$()$()

pages.title: getItemCount
pages.text: $(method)getItemCount$()($(param)itemId$())$(br2)Free provider stock of one item (not craft-only availability).$(br2)$(note)Returns$()$(br)$(li)$(type)number$() — count, or $(code)0$() if none$(br2)$(note)Example$()$(br)$(code)p.$(method)getItemCount$()($(str)"minecraft:oak_log"$())$()

pages.title: request
pages.text: $(method)request$()($(param)itemId$(), $(param)count$())$(br2)Commits whatever the network can source right now (same idea as the Request GUI).$(br2)$(note)Returns$()$(br)$(li)$(field)shipped$() $(type)number$() — accepted onto the network$(li)$(field)requested$() $(type)number$() — your ask$(li)$(field)complete$() $(type)boolean$() — shipped >= requested$(br2)$(note)Example$()$(br)$(code)p.$(method)request$()($(str)"minecraft:oak_log"$(), $(code)64$())$()

pages.title: canRequest
pages.text: $(method)canRequest$()($(param)itemId$(), $(param)count$())$(br2)Plans only — does $(thing)not$() commit anything.$(br2)$(note)Returns$()$(br)$(li)$(field)satisfiable$() $(type)boolean$() — full ask is possible$(li)$(field)missing$() $(type)table?$() — list of {$(field)name$(), $(field)count$()}$(br2)$(note)Example$()$(br)$(code)p.$(method)canRequest$()($(str)"minecraft:diamond"$(), $(code)16$())$()
